context.label: Passover, covenant, and table before the night

observations.body: A sword is summoned against the shepherd; the sheep scatter, the little ones face God’s hand, and a remnant passes through refining toward covenant speech.
observations.label: The shepherd is struck and the sheep scatter

observations.body: The passage presents Striking, scattering, refining, and calling as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Striking, scattering, refining, and calling

observations.body: The passage places Quoted after the supper beside Striking, scattering, refining, and calling.
observations.label: Quoted after the supper

payload.posture: Read Zechariah 13:7–9 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a sword is summoned against the shepherd; the sheep scatter, the little ones face God’s hand, and a remnant passes through refining toward covenant speech. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: The shepherd is struck and the sheep scatter
